test-set.name: ft-UseCase-SCORE
test-set.description: XQuery Full Text - Use Case "SCORE" - Queries that must be written with score. Section 17.

test-case.name: score-queries-results-q1
test-case.description: Q1 Query Returning Scores: Find all books which mention "usability" in the title or the text. Return book titles and scores. This query performs a word query and returns scores, highest scores first. Score is implementation-dependent, so any answer is acceptable, a few possible answers are provided.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test score-queries-results-q1

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; for $book in $input-context/books/book let score $s := ($book/metadata/title contains text "usability" or $book/content contains text "usability") where $s > 0 order by $s descending return <book number="{$book/@number}"> {$book/metadata/title} <score>{$s}</score> </book>

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
$result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
$result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)

test-case.name: score-queries-results-q2
test-case.description: Q2 Query Returning Results with Top Scores: Find the best two books on "usability". This query performs a word query and returns only the results with the two top scores. Score is implementation-dependent, so any answer is acceptable, a few possible answers are provided.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test score-queries-results-q2

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; for $result at $i in for $book score $s in $input-context/books/book[. contains text "usability"] order by $s ascending return $book where $i <= 2 return <book number="{$result/@number}"> {$result/metadata/title}</book>

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
$result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)

test-case.name: score-queries-results-q5
test-case.description: Q5 Query Returning All Books Ordered by Score: Return all books, listing books with text on "software" first. This query performs a word query, returns all the documents in the database, and orders them returning those with found word first, those without last. Score is implementation-dependent, so any answer is acceptable, a few possible answers are provided.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test score-queries-results-q5

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; for $book in $input-context/books/book let score $s := $book/content contains text "software" order by $s descending return $book

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
$result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)

test-case.name: score-queries-results-q6
test-case.description: Q6 Query with Weight Declaration: Finds books which discuss "conducting usability tests" returning those which mention "measuring success" first. This query finds words using weighting on optional words to impact the scoring and sorting. Score is implementation-dependent, so any answer is acceptable, a few possible answers are provided.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test score-queries-results-q6

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; for $book in $input-context/books/book let $booktext := $book/content [. contains text ("conduct" ftand "usability" ftand "tests" distance at most 10 words) using stemming] let score $s := $booktext contains text (("measuring" ftand "success" distance at most 4 words) weight {1.8}) using stemming where $booktext order by $s descending return ($book/metadata/title, $booktext)

any-of.assert: $result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
$result instance of item()* (: any non-error result is OK :)
